newsitem.title: UK: NWE fuel oil steady, barges up $1 on better bunker.
newsitem.headline: NWE fuel oil steady, barges up $1 on better bunker.

text.p: NWE fuel oil markets were inactive on Friday morning, although high sulphur barges gained $1 on better bunker demand, traders said.
Barges traded in Rotterdam at $83 fob in early business and at $84 fob in Antwerp before drifting down later.
Offers were at $82.50 for balance of month delivery. One trader reported a British major buying heavily but others could not see it. Bunker demand was said to be good or moderate.
High sulphur cargoes were static with participants watching reports that cracked material may flow from the Mediterranean to the Far East.
Opinions differed on the strength of the support this would offer to the northern market.
Low sulphur cracked and straight-run markets were steady.
